description: Immediate-mode terminal UI library for .NET 10: redraw the whole UI each frame into a cell buffer; TUI.NET diffs it and writes only the changes. Zero allocations per frame, Native AOT.
rules: Install with `dotnet add package Tuinet`; the namespaces are Tuinet and Tuinet.Widgets. Requires .NET 10.
TUI.NET is immediate mode: keep state in your app and redraw the whole UI every frame (BeginFrame, render, Present). There is no widget tree to retain or update.
Prefer `term.Run(app)` with an IApp (Handle returns false to quit, Render draws everything) over a hand-written loop.
In a manual loop, drain pending input with `term.Poll(out ev, 0)` before drawing once, so a burst of keys costs one frame.
Test UIs with Tuinet.Testing (`dotnet add package Tuinet.Testing`): TestTerminal drives an IApp without a real terminal, and Snapshot.Verify compares a frame with a committed snapshot.
